jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER HEMSTÄDARE I VÄRMDÖ – BLI EN DEL AV VÅRT TEAM!
Vill du ha ett jobb där du verkligen gör skillnad i människors vardag? Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, fönsterputs och andra tjänster i hemmet, alltid med kvalitet och omtanke.
Nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som städare i Värmdö med omnejd. Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team med kollegor från hela världen, tillsammans levererar vi service i världsklass!
Vad erbjuder vi?
· En tjänst på 75 %
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad
· Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänst
· Betalt restid mellan kunderna
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)
· Vi värnar om din hälsa! Därför erbjuder vi ett friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år
· Gratis mobilabonnemang
· Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning
· Field Lead/Buddy – kontaktperson inom städning samt stöd till medarbetare ute på fältet
· Teamträffar och gemensamma fester
Hos oss får du rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas. Har du viljan, så ger vi dig verktygen för att briljera!

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som:
· Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och i team
· Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och engagerad
· Vill utvecklas och lära dig mer
· Talar svenska eller engelska
· Kan arbeta flexibla arbetstider (måndag–fredag kl. 08.00–17.00)
· Är flexibel och trivs med att arbeta hos olika kunder
Meriterande:
· B-körkort (egen bil är ett plus)
· Erfarenhet av städning eller serviceyrken

Utvecklingsmöjligheter inom Hemfrid Inom vår kollektivverksamhet finns flera olika roller och utvecklingsvägar. Vårt mål är att alla medarbetare ska få möjlighet att lära sig, utvecklas och växa inom Hemfrid. Genom erfarenhet, utbildning och nya ansvarsområden kan du steg för steg utvecklas och ta dig an nya roller inom företaget.

Ansök redan idag! Läs mer på www.hemfrid.se/karriar och ansök  Har du frågor? Kontakta oss gärna på hr@hemfrid.se
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! ✨

Join us as a Senior Reliability Engineer and play a key role in ensuring the long-term performance and reliability of critical manufacturing assets.
The position is part of the local Maintenance & Reliability organisation in Uppsala and works cross-functionally with Engineering, Production, Quality Assurance and other key stakeholders.
As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will act as a key technical specialist on both operational and strategic levels, driving the development of a proactive, data-driven reliability and maintenance culture. You will also collaborate closely with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with corporate standards, best practices and long-term strategic objectives.
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive mindset, takes ownership of complex challenges and is motivated by turning analysis into action.
Make your mark. Grow with us. 
 
Your mission
As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability and long-term performance of manufacturing systems and equipment across our operations.
Using data, engineering expertise and structured problem solving, you will identify improvement opportunities, assess equipment and asset lifecycles, and support decisions on maintenance strategies, upgrades and future investments.
In this role, you will provide subject matter expertise in reliability engineering and asset performance management, supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives. Through collaboration with local and global stakeholders, you will help shape maintenance practices, improve asset reliability and contribute to sustainable business performance.
This is a senior role that requires a high degree of ownership and initiative. You are comfortable working independently, building strong relationships across functions and driving improvements from idea through to implementation.
You will join a team of experienced engineers who play an important role in supporting operational excellence and the continued development of our Uppsala site.
 
Key Responsibilities
· Drive reliability engineering initiatives across manufacturing operations, systems and equipment.
· Lead and facilitate reliability assessments using methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA and FMECA.
· Analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement measurable reliability improvements.
· Develop and optimise preventive maintenance strategies to improve asset availability and reduce operational risk.
· Support asset lifecycle management and contribute to investment decisions through data-driven recommendations.
· Monitor and improve maintenance performance indicators (KPIs) and reliability metrics.
· Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Production, Automation, QA and Facilities to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
· Collaborate with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with company standards and strategic objectives.
· Promote a proactive, reliability-focused culture through coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.
· Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve operational performance
 
Your profile 
You are an experienced engineer with a background in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management within an industrial environment.
You are comfortable working with complex technical challenges and understand how to translate data into practical actions and long-term improvements. Equally important, you take ownership, build trust with stakeholders and thrive in an environment where initiative and collaboration are valued.
 
What you'll bring
· A university degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
· Minimum 5 years of experience within reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management in an industrial environment.
· Strong knowledge and practical experience of reliability methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA/FMECA and preventive maintenance optimisation.
· Proven ability to analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement sustainable reliability improvements.
· Experience working with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and maintenance performance indicators (KPIs).
· Strong knowledge of asset lifecycle management and maintenance strategies.
· Experience from a regulated manufacturing environment.
· Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
· Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken. Swedish is considered an advantage.
 
Location and other
This position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore encourage interested candidates to submit their application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
 
With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
 
Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
 
We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
 
By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
 
Project Director at atNorth
 
Are you an experienced project leader who thrives on taking ownership of complex, large-scale construction projects?
 
We are looking for a Project Director to lead the delivery of one of our major data center projects in Sweden. In this key role, you will have end-to-end accountability from contract award through construction, commissioning and handover to Operations, ensuring the project is delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the quality expected by atNorth and our customers.
 
You will lead the atNorth project organization and act as our senior delivery representative towards the general contractor, customer and key stakeholders. This is an opportunity to combine leadership, commercial expertise and project delivery while contributing directly to atNorth’s continued growth across the Nordics.
 
Key responsibilities
 
 
Take end-to-end ownership of the assigned project, delivering against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, HSE and Ready for Service (RFS) commitments.

 
Lead the atNorth project organization and build the right team and capabilities for each phase of delivery.

 
Participate in general contractor tendering, evaluation and contract negotiations, and take full accountability from contract award.

 
Manage the GC contract and protect atNorth’s commercial and contractual position, including variations, claims, costs and schedule impacts.

 
Own project cost, schedule and risk forecasting, proactively identifying deviations and escalating risks early.

 
Act as atNorth’s senior delivery interface towards the customer, managing technical requirements, design changes and acceptance.

 
Lead commissioning and integrated systems testing through to successful handover to Operations.

 
Drive a strong health, safety and quality culture, ensuring contracted standards are consistently met.

 
Lead, coach and develop project managers, leads and specialists across the project organization.

 
Ensure strong project governance, reporting, documentation and close-out, while capturing lessons learned to continuously improve future delivery.

 
 
Your profile
 
 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

 
10+ years of experience leading large-scale construction, infrastructure or mission-critical projects.

 
Proven experience of owner-side project delivery, ideally from contract award through construction, commissioning and operational handover.

 
Strong commercial and contractual experience, including contract administration, variations, claims and cost and schedule management.

 
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary project teams, consultants and contractors in complex project environments.

 
Strong stakeholder and customer management skills, with the confidence to make decisions and communicate clearly in challenging situations.

 
Experience from data centers or other mission-critical environments is strongly preferred. Experience from energy, industrial or other complex infrastructure environments is also relevant.

 
Fluency in English is required. Swedish or another relevant local language is preferred.

 
Experience with Nordic construction standards such as ABT 06, or international standards such as FIDIC or NEC, is an advantage. Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is also highly valued.
 
About the atNorth Culture
 
We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.
We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.
At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.
Welcome to apply!

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join us as a Layout Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in coordinating the overall design of our projects. You will leverage your strong CAD skills, preferably in NX, to create and manage 3D models that accurately reflect the combined input from various engineering disciplines. Your attention to detail and structured approach will ensure that all layout drawings meet project requirements and support customer planning for foundations, buildings, and utilities. Collaborating closely with project teams and customers, you will contribute to successful project execution while continuously learning and developing your knowledge of our products and engineering processes. This role is based in Finspång, and you will need to be present on-site, with some flexibility required for business travel to visit customers as needed.
 
How You’ll Make an Impact
 You will utilize your CAD expertise to create and manage detailed 3D models, ensuring alignment with mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines.
 Collaborate effectively with project teams and customers to produce layout drawings that facilitate early-stage planning and site preparation activities.
 Maintain a structured approach to ensure that the layout remains aligned with project requirements throughout the lifecycle, adapting as necessary.
 Foster strong communication and collaboration within an international environment to prevent design clashes and ensure cohesive project execution.
 Contribute to building a long-term engineering support capability that enhances our Layout Engineering team in Finspång.
  
What You Bring
 A University degree in Mechanical Engineering.
 Several years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in gas turbines, power generation, or oil and gas sectors.
 Demonstrated expertise in 3D CAD modeling (Siemens NX preferred) and PLM systems (ideally Teamcenter).
 Strong technical skills in mechanical systems design, steel structure design, and project management.
 Advanced English proficiency for effective intercultural communication and collaboration.
 Attention to detail, structured working style, and excellent communication skills to engage with diverse teams and customers.
 Willingness to learn about our products and engineering processes, with flexibility for business travel as needed.
  
About the Team
The team currently consist of 12 engineers from different parts of the world and with different backgrounds.
 We help each other to build a strong technical knowledge within the team and take joint responsibility to reach our goals.
 Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
 We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
 Who is Siemens Energy?
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 Application
 Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 305745 no later than 2026-12-06.
 Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

jobs.description:
Husbils och husvagnstekniker till EW Fritid i Uppsala
En värmepanna som stannar, ett kylskåp som inte kyler eller solceller som ska monteras inför leverans. Som husbils- och husvagnstekniker hos oss arbetar du med systemen och utrustningen i bodelen på både husbilar och husvagnar. Nu söker vi en kollega till vår verkstad i Fyrislund.
EW Fritid säljer och servar husbilar och husvagnar. Vi är auktoriserad återförsäljare och verkstad för Kabe, Adria, Sun Living och Dethleffs. På vår anläggning i Uppsala finns också två försäljningshallar och en KAMA-butik. EW Fritid är en del av BosseBil, som bedriver verksamhet på flera anläggningar.
Ditt jobb i verkstaden
Serva och reparera husbilar och husvagnar, med fokus på bodelen.
Felsöka el-, gasol-, vatten- och värmesystem.
Reparera och byta komponenter och utrustning.
Montera tillbehör som solceller, markiser och antenner.
Gå igenom utfört arbete med kunden vid behov.

Du tar ansvar för dina jobb från felsökning till färdig reparation. När ett fel är svårt att hitta har du erfarna kollegor att bolla med.
Vem vi söker
Du gillar att lösa tekniska problem och arbetar metodiskt, även när det är mycket att göra. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt, samarbetar bra med kollegor och kan förklara för kunden vad du har gjort.
Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av fordonsreparationer, el, elektronik, VVS eller annat praktiskt tekniskt arbete. Erfarenhet av husbilar eller husvagnar är meriterande.
B-körkort är ett krav.
Arbetstid och anställningsvillkor
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med arbete på vardagar enligt schema.
Lönen sätts utifrån erfarenhet och kompetens. Vi använder Motorbranschavtalet som riktmärke för lön och övriga anställningsvillkor.
Tjänsten klassificeras enligt SSYK 2012 som 7231 – Motorfordonsmekaniker och fordonsreparatörer.

Genom vårt försäkringsavtal med Fora omfattas anställda arbetare av Avtalspension SAF-LO, avtalsgruppsjukförsäkring (AGS), tjänstegrupplivförsäkring (TGL) och trygghetsförsäkring vid arbetsskada (TFA).
Ansökan
Skicka ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev till jesper.skyten@ewfritid.se senast 18 december 2026.
Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla länder. Du kan söka på svenska eller engelska.
Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och kan hålla intervjuer under ansökningstiden.
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Jesper Skytén, servicemarknadschef, på samma mejladress.

__________________________________________________

Motorhome and Caravan Technician at EW Fritid in Uppsala, Sweden
We’re looking for a technician to join our workshop in Fyrislund, Uppsala. EW Fritid sells and services motorhomes and caravans and is an authorised dealer and workshop for Kabe, Adria, Sun Living and Dethleffs. Our Uppsala site also includes two vehicle showrooms and a KAMA accessories shop. EW Fritid is part of BosseBil, which operates at several locations.
The role
You’ll service and repair equipment and systems in the living areas of motorhomes and caravans. The work includes troubleshooting electrical, LPG, water and heating systems, replacing components and fitting accessories such as solar panels, awnings and antennas.
You’ll take responsibility for jobs from diagnosis to completion and explain the work to customers when needed. Experienced colleagues are available to help with more complex faults.
Who we’re looking for
You enjoy solving technical problems, work methodically and are comfortable working independently as well as part of a team.
Experience in vehicle repair, electrical or electronic systems, plumbing or another practical technical trade is welcome. Experience with motorhomes or caravans is an advantage.
A valid Category B driving licence is required.
Employment terms
This is a permanent, full-time position with scheduled weekday working hours.
Pay is based on experience and qualifications. We use the Swedish motor industry agreement (Motorbranschavtalet) as a benchmark for pay and other employment terms. 
The position is classified as SSYK 7231 – Motor Vehicle Mechanics and Vehicle Repairers.

Through our insurance agreement with Fora, employees classified as workers are covered by the SAF-LO occupational pension scheme, AGS group sickness insurance, TGL group life insurance and TFA occupational injury insurance.
How to apply
Email your CV and a short cover letter in Swedish or English to jesper.skyten@ewfritid.se by 18 December 2026.
Applications from all countries are welcome. We review applications as they come in and may hold interviews before the deadline.
If you have questions about the role, contact Jesper Skytén, Aftersales Manager, at the same email address.

Nordic Product Manager International & Customs, Nordic Parcel Product Management
Make cross-border journeys work better and turn product ideas into measurable results. As Nordic Product Manager International & Customs, you will manage and develop international services and customs-related services for both import and export. This is a role for a commercially minded product professional who connects customer needs with operational reality, challenges established approaches and brings people together to turn approved priorities into delivery.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
PostNord offers a flexible hybrid workplace in an unpretentious, collaborative environment where colleagues support each other in reaching shared goals. Independent leadership and professional development are encouraged. Benefits include:
A Nordic and flexible working environment, based at PostNord´s offices in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen.
Great development and career opportunities.
Good insurance and occupational pension terms.
For Stockholm-based employees, a wellness allowance and access to Arken´s gym and indoor swimming pool.
Employee benefits through PostNord Plus, PostNord´s own personnel foundation.
Employment conditions under collective agreements.

Your Responsibilities
Nordic Parcel Product Management develops PostNord’s Nordic parcel portfolio, turning customer and operational needs into product priorities and solutions.
You translate portfolio direction into product proposals, business cases, requirements and actionable plans, driving assigned initiatives across countries and functions to improve customer experience, revenue, cost efficiency and profitable growth.
Reporting to the Manager Solutions Area B2B & International, who owns portfolio strategy, roadmap priorities, resources and lifecycle decisions, you lead product development and implementation within agreed scope and mandate.
Product scope and development: Develop roadmap proposals, improvements, service logic, requirements and acceptance criteria for international and customs-related import and export services, based on customer journeys, market insights, operational needs and country requirements.
Cross-functional leadership: Coordinate Operations, IT, Legal, customs experts, Customer Service, Commercial and country teams to ensure workable import/export flows, data requirements and operational feasibility. Lead through collaboration, including agreed contributions from the Product Specialist Customs/Export, without line-management responsibility. Legal and customs experts retain regulatory interpretation and validation responsibilities.
Business cases and decisions: Work with Finance, Pricing, Analytics, Operations, IT and countries to assess customer value, revenue, costs, feasibility, risks and implementation needs. Present recommendations and secure decisions through your manager and relevant forums.
Implementation and launch: Lead approved development initiatives, launches, changes, migrations and phase-outs, coordinating requirements, milestones, dependencies, operational readiness, rollout and post-launch follow-up. Collaborate with Strategic Pricing on pricing readiness and VP/CX on commercial readiness, customer materials and activation. The Product Specialist Customs/Export maintains detailed specifications, documentation, product master data and setup.
Performance and follow-up: Monitor assumptions and actual outcomes, recommend improvements and communicate progress, risks and readiness. Escalate matters affecting portfolio priorities, budgets, resources or launch decisions, with clear recommendations on unresolved trade-offs.

The Bigger Picture
At PostNord, the role turns international product priorities into practical improvements across import and export journeys. Working across Nordic markets and functions, you combine commercial thinking with hands-on delivery and measurable customer and business impact.
Our Expectations
Relevant experience in product management, cross-border services, business development or complex implementation work in a cross-functional environment.
Understanding of international parcel flows, import and export journeys, customs-related service requirements and how customer experience, operations, systems, revenue and cost connect.
A commercially oriented and analytical product mindset, turning data and insight into product proposals, business cases, requirements and delivery plans.
Strong execution skills to lead initiatives from an approved business case through implementation and follow-up, create structure, address dependencies and keep delivery moving.
Strong stakeholder management skills to align specialists, functions and countries around shared outcomes, take ownership within your mandate and know when to seek a decision.
University degree, college degree or equivalent higher education qualification.
Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one Nordic language.

The successful candidate works in line with PostNord’s principles: Accountable-owning assigned product deliverables, business cases, execution and follow-up; Brave-challenging assumptions, highlighting risks and trade-offs and presenting clear recommendations; and Committed-aligning stakeholders and following through from customer need to implementation and measurable outcomes.
Interested?
We work with TNG in this recruitment process. They are recruitment specialists in unbiased and competence based recruitment, which creates diversity and innovation in teams and contribute to a sustainable employment market. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

jobs.occupation: Vi söker Teknikinformatörer för Flight- & underhållsmanualer!
jobs.description:
Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.  

Din roll

Som Teknikinformatör fungerar du som länken mellan utvecklare och slutanvändare, där du omsätter komplex teknisk information till tydligt, strukturerat och användaranpassat innehåll.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar att:
Ta fram samt genomföra revisioner på teknisk dokumentation i form av flightmanualer för GlobalEye-systemet.
Samla in, analysera och kvalitetssäkra teknisk information från olika källor och intressenter.
Utforma pedagogiskt innehåll med hjälp av text och bild för att göra komplex teknik lättillgänglig och användarvänlig.

I rollen kommer du arbeta i nära samarbete med både kollegor och externa samarbetspartners. Du kommer bland annat att stötta kollegor inom språk, struktur och pedagogiskt skrivande. Samtidigt kommer du att spela en viktig roll i arbetet med att utveckla och effektivisera arbetssätt, metoder och processer inom teknikinformation.
Du blir en del av organisationen Technical Information inom avdelningen Special Mission & Regional Aircraft (SMRA). SMRA levererar ett brett utbud av tjänster och integrerade supportlösningar till kunder inom försvar och på kommersiell marknad för kostnadseffektiv support av system och plattformar under hela livscykeln
Hos oss får du arbeta i ett kompetent och sammansvetsat team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och arbetsglädje värderas högt. Vi erbjuder en utvecklande miljö med goda möjligheter att växa och ta nästa steg i din karriär. Du har möjlighet att utgå från vårt kontor i Linköping eller Nyköping.
 

Din profil

Som person är du analytisk och har lätt för att se samband, samtidigt som du värdesätter kvalitet och har ett öga för detaljer. Du trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor och samarbetar effektivt med olika parter genom att kommunicera tydligt och sätta dig in i andras perspektiv.

Du tar eget ansvar och driver arbete framåt där du på ett lösningsorienterat sätt hittar vägar framåt, även när förutsättningarna förändras eller inte är helt tydliga. Du söker aktivt den information du behöver och trivs i en dynamisk miljö där du får kombinera struktur, engagemang och flexibilitet.
Vi ser att du har:
Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis flygteknik, kognitionsvetenskap eller ingenjörsområdet - alternativt flera års erfarenhet av arbete med teknisk information
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa produkter eller tekniska tjänster där struktur, noggrannhet och systemförståelse är avgörande
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande:
Erfarenhet av pilotyrket
Erfarenhet av arbete med teknisk dokumentation enligt etablerade standarder, exempelvis S1000D eller iSpec2200
Erfarenhet av arbete med taggning i XML eller SGML.

Securitas Risk Intelligence delivers actionable intelligence on the global security and threat landscape, creating decision-making advantage and confidence to protect people, property, and assets. About the role
Reporting to the CFO of Security Risk Management (SRM) and being part of SRI Leadership Team - the Finance Business Partner owns business controlling and performance management for SRI and acts as the finance business partner to VP SRI. The role will make SRI’s economics more visible and actionable, while establishing a more rigorous, forward-looking and technology-enabled approach to commercial, financial and operational performance. The role will be collaborating with dedicated financial control and financial shared service.
SRI needs stronger dedicated financial ownership and deeper performance insight. The role will improve the speed and quality of decisions, strengthen adherence to the financial model, raise the quality of business cases and create systematic follow-up on expected benefits, supporting sustainable and profitable growth.
Responsibilities

Business partnering and decision support: Act as the day-to-day finance partner to VP SRI and SRI leadership. Translate commercial and operational choices into financial implications, alternatives and recommendations. Challenge assumptions constructively and maintain an independent finance perspective.

Performance management: Own the SRI performance view across commercial performance, financial results, operational drivers and forward-looking indicators. Business cases and benefits tracking: Strengthen the quality and consistency of investment and commercial business cases. Test assumptions, quantify scenarios and risks, and establish disciplined post-decision follow-up against expected outcomes.

Reporting, data and automation: Improve data structures, definitions and controls. Use automation and AI where they materially improve speed, quality, scalability or insight.

Leverage the Controller's ownership of financial control, data integrity and recurring processes to enable stronger performance management and business decision support.

Candidate profile

Analytical strength: analytical ability and data literacy. Able to structure ambiguous questions, reconcile conflicting information, identify root causes and form evidence-based conclusions.

Commercial judgement: Understands that finance exists to improve decisions, not only to report results. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders while remaining pragmatic.

Communication: Able to explain conclusions clearly and focus stakeholders on what matters. Executive polish is desirable but can be developed. Fluency in English.

Experience in business controlling, FP&A, performance management, transaction services, consulting, revenue operations or a comparable analytical finance role.

Demonstrated ownership of complex analysis, planning or business-case work, not only production of recurring reports.

Experience working with/presenting to senior business stakeholders.

Evidence of improving a process, analysis or decision workflow through better use of data, systems, automation or AI.

University degree in finance, economics, engineering, data or a comparable discipline.

Personal characteristics

Curious and willing to investigate until the underlying logic is understood.

Independent in judgement and effective in a collaborative environment.

High ownership and pace, with the discipline to finish and follow through.

Comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader commercial implications.

Ambitious to grow and motivated by building capability and improving the business.

Hybrid model applies (with 3 days in the office per week).
